subject: BlueHarbor activation boost — combined credits + short-term rate concession
messages:
From: Alyssa Cortez <alyssa@blueharbor.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.io
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: activation boost — credits + short-term rate concession

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the pilot. The engineering team positively surprised us on throughput during the POC — we've started internal conversations about moving forward, but procurement is asking for a small activation package to get the first quarter running while we finalize budget and the SOW.

Concretely, would Redwood consider: 60k in free credits applied to the first 30 days (to smooth ingest/testing spikes) plus a temporary 15% unit-rate discount for 2 months if we sign a 12-month committed plan at net-new ARR >= $120k?

I've attached the mutual action plan (BlueHarbor_MAP_v2.pdf) and a procurement intent PDF. We can move quickly on a DocuSign if we get an executive OK for a one-time concession.

Appreciate any flexibility — this gets us past procurement friction and would put Redwood at the top of our shortlist.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Cortez
Head of Platform Partnerships
BlueHarbor Analytics


From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cortez <alyssa@blueharbor.io>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.io, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: activation boost — credits + short-term rate concession

Alyssa — really appreciate the clear ask and the MAP. Great to hear the POC performance resonated with the team.

Quick answers: I can apply a 60k activation credit against the first billing cycle, and we can set up a temporary 15% off unit rate for two months, contingent on a signed 12-month commit at the threshold you noted. I do need an executive exception to finalize the credits + temporary rate in our billing system for a customer of this size.

Hannah — looping you and Aditya for exec clearance. Attached the MAP and PO intent that Alyssa referenced.

Next steps from my side if we get approval: 1) finalize a quick amendment/DocuSign for the activation credit + temporary rate; 2) set billing schedule to apply credit up-front; 3) run enablement kickoff with BH eng team this week.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: activation boost — credits + short-term rate concession

Folks — forwarding Alyssa's request and the MAP. Short summary and ask: BlueHarbor is asking for a one-time 60k activation credit plus a temporary 15% off unit rate for 60 days, conditioned on signing a 12-month commit >= $120k net new ARR. They've indicated procurement will move fast if we can offer an express exception.

Rationale: strong POC, product fit, and strategic signal for analytics vertical. Risk: upfront credit impact (~$60k) but likely offsets churn risk and shortens time to revenue.

Proposed guardrails if we approve: 
- Credit applied only to first 30 days and forfeited if they don't sign within 30 days of amendment execution
- 15% temporary rate automatically expires after 60 days
- Signed 12-mo commit must be executed within 45 days of credit issuance
- Require PO intent + exec sign-off (we have both)

Request: Exec concession authority to approve the credit + temporary rate as described. Approver: Aditya (revenue ops + pricing escalation) or Marissa (VP Sales) — Jordan will own deal ops once greenlit.

Attachment: BlueHarbor_MAP_v2.pdf, PO_Intent.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan


From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: activation boost — credits + short-term rate concession

Thanks for the context, Jordan. I reviewed the MAP and the numbers. I'm comfortable approving this with the guardrails you proposed, with two clarifications:

1) If BlueHarbor doesn't execute the 12-month commit within 45 days, any unused portion of the 60k credit will be clawed back (we record as a contra-revenue and reverse credits). Finance to be looped for the accounting entry.
2) The temporary 15% discount will only apply to metered usage above our standard starter tier thresholds; it won't apply to platform add-ons or professional services. Please add explicit language to the amendment.

Marissa / Hannah — tagging you for visibility. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, I'll sign off and coordinate with Legal and RevOps to draft the amendment and the DocuSign packet. Jordan: please prepare the amendment language and the HubSpot deal update.

Aditya
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference


From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cortez <alyssa@blueharbor.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@blueharbor.io
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: activation boost — BlueHarbor (next steps + amendment)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the MAP and for moving quickly. We're excited to partner with BlueHarbor.

Executive decision: Redwood will provide the one-time $60,000 activation credit to apply against the first billing cycle and a temporary 15% unit-rate concession for two months, subject to the following binding conditions:

- The $60,000 credit is applied only to the first 30 days of usage and is forfeited if a signed 12-month commitment at >= $120,000 net-new ARR is not executed within 45 days of amendment signature.
- The 15% temporary discount applies only to metered inference usage above starter-tier thresholds and excludes platform add-ons and professional services.
- BlueHarbor will sign a short amendment (DocuSign link below) reflecting the credit, discount period, and clawback language.
- We will require a PO intent or purchase order following amendment execution; billing schedules will reflect credit application at invoice creation.

Jordan will send the amendment via DocuSign once Legal and RevOps insert the clarified language. You should expect the DocuSign packet by end of day tomorrow.

DocuSign (prelim): https://www.docusign.com/exec/BlueHarbor-Activation-DocuSign
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/789123/BH-4820

Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales — West
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: BlueHarbor_MAP_v2.pdf, PO_Intent.pdf
